paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Abba, colleague of the aforementioned R. Yehudah the priest; see another one above. Eduyot, chapter 6: he testified to five laws. Our version is R. Yehudah ben Bava. Yuchasin, sequence of generations under Yehudah ben Abba, records the Abba reading. Tefillat HaShachar, Berakhot 27a, says R. Yehudah ben Bava testified to those five matters. I would have said this is R. Yehudah ben Bava, since Bava and Abba are one thing, but Rambam counts them as two.
